no_target_yet.statement: If $\operatorname{CDC}(G)\cong\operatorname{CDC}(H)$, there is a vertex bijection between $G$ and $H$ under which $p_G(\lambda)$ and $p_H(\lambda)$ agree for every real $\lambda$. In particular the weights, main eigenspaces and the restrictions of the adjacency matrices to those main eigenspaces agree under one common relabelling.
